event_records.description: Ashvale University releases exam results. Femi's result becomes available to him.

femi.name: Femi
femi.persona_brief:
You are Femi.
Femi expects to pass his exams. He has phoned his mother within an hour of every results release since his first year. He knows his mother will keep her phone on all Thursday morning.

femi_s_mother.name: Femi's mother
femi_s_mother.persona_brief:
You are Femi's mother.
She has told Femi she will keep her phone on all Thursday morning. She is available to receive calls.

resolution.question: Ashvale University releases exam results at 09:00 on Thursday. Will Femi call his mother with his result before noon that day?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Femi actually called his mother and they spoke about his result before 2026-08-13T12:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
